arxiv-1911-12521.creator: R. T. Ndongmo, S. Mahamat, T. B. Bouetou, T. C. Kofane
arxiv-1911-12521.description: Abstract pacs 04.70.−s, 95.30.Lz, 04.70.Dy, 98.80.Cq I I. INTRODUCTION The discovery in the early 1970s that black holes radiate as black bodies has radically affect our understanding of general relativity, and offer us some early hints about the nature of quantum gravity. As a result, black holes may behave as thermodynamic objects, with characteristic temperature and entropy.

arxiv-2205-12490.creator: Zhiyang Xu, Jay-Yoon Lee, Lifu Huang
arxiv-2205-12490.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhiyang Xu, Jay-Yoon Lee, Lifu Huang. Data scarcity has been the main factor that hinders the progress of event extraction. To overcome this issue, we propose a S elf- T raining with F eedback ( Stf ) framework that leverages the large-scale unlabeled data and acquires feedback for each new event prediction from the unlabeled data by comparing it to the Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) graph of the same sentence.

arxiv-2504-03344.title: Chiral environment effects on the dynamics of a central chiral molecule
arxiv-2504-03344.creator: Daniel Martínez-Gil, Pedro Bargueño, Salvador Miret-Artés
arxiv-2504-03344.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Daniel Martínez-Gil, Pedro Bargueño, Salvador Miret-Artés. In this work, we develop a system plus environment approach for interacting chiral molecules under a quantum-classical description of the spin-spin model using a Caldeira-Leggett-like coupling. After presenting the interacting model, we show that a long-ranged parity-nonconserving interaction, encoded within a non-linear Schrödinger equation, produces an energy difference between the two enantiomers of the central chiral molecule when it interacts with a chiral environment.

arxiv-2512-15931.title: BarcodeMamba+: Advancing State-Space Models for Fungal Biodiversity Research
arxiv-2512-15931.creator: Tiancheng Gao, Scott C. Lowe, Brendan Furneaux, Angel X. Chang, Graham W. Taylor
arxiv-2512-15931.description: Abstract Accurate taxonomic classification from DNA barcodes is a cornerstone of global biodiversity monitoring, yet fungi present extreme challenges due to sparse labelling and long-tailed taxa distributions. Conventional supervised learning methods often falter in this domain, struggling to generalize to unseen species and to capture the hierarchical nature of the data.

pmc-10673371.title: Evaluation of GABA Production by Alginate-Microencapsulated Fresh and Freeze-Dried Bacteria Enriched with Monosodium Glutamate during Storage in Chocolate Milk
pmc-10673371.creator: Hebat Allah Ibrahim Youssef, Paola Vitaglione, Rosalia Ferracane, Jumana Abuqwider, Gianluigi Mauriello, Mutamed Ayyash
pmc-10673371.description: Two strains of γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) producing bacteria, L. brevis Y1 and L. plantarum LM2, were microencapsulated in sodium alginate with two concentrations (1% and 2%) of monosodium glutamate (MSG) by using vibrating technology. The mix of both species was microencapsulated both in fresh and freeze-dried form.

pmc-10716117.title: Pfs230 Domain 7 is targeted by a potent malaria transmission-blocking monoclonal antibody
pmc-10716117.creator: Maartje R Inklaar, Roos M de Jong, Ezra T Bekkering, Hikaru Nagaoka, Felix L Fennemann, Karina Teelen, Marga van de Vegte-Bolmer, Geert-Jan van Gemert, Rianne Stoter, C Richter King, Nicholas I Proellochs, Teun Bousema, Eizo Takashima, Takafumi Tsuboi, Matthijs M Jore
pmc-10716117.description: Malaria transmission-blocking vaccines (TBVs) aim to induce antibodies that block Plasmodium parasite development in the mosquito midgut, thus preventing mosquitoes from becoming infectious. While the Pro-domain and first of fourteen 6-Cysteine domains (Pro-D1) of the Plasmodium gamete surface protein Pfs230 are known targets of transmission-blocking antibodies, no studies to date have discovered other Pfs230 domains that are functional targets.

pmc-11298746.title: Supported decision-making with persons with dementia: a scoping review protocol in partnership with lived experts
pmc-11298746.creator: Tamara Sussman, Xue Ping Ma, Oluwagbemiga Oyinlola, Amanda Grenier, M Ariel Cascio, Lynn McCleary, Paulette V Hunter, Maryse Soulières, Rym Zakaria
pmc-11298746.description: IntroductionThe United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities asserts that all persons with disabilities have the right to receive the support they require to participate in decisions that affect them. Yet, persons with dementia continue to be excluded from decisions on issues that matter to them.

pmc-11428130.title: Partial to Total Generation of 3D Transition-Metal Complexes
pmc-11428130.creator: Hongni Jin, Kenneth M Merz
pmc-11428130.description: The design of transition-metal complexes (TMCs) has drawn much attention over the years because of their important applications as metallodrugs and functional materials. In this work, we present an extension of our recently reported approach, LigandDiff [Jin et al. J. Chem. Theory Comput.20, 4377(2024)]. The new model, which we call multi-LigandDiff, is more flexible and greatly outperforms its predecessor.

pmc-11431943.title: MIND Diet Impact on Multiple Sclerosis Patients: Biochemical Changes after Nutritional Intervention
pmc-11431943.creator: Ainoa Navarrete-Pérez, Sara Gómez-Melero, Begoña Mª Escribano, Alejandro Galvao-Carmona, Cristina Conde-Gavilán, Mª Ángeles Peña-Toledo, Noelia Villarrubia, Luisa Mª Villar, Isaac Túnez, Eduardo Agüera-Morales, Javier Caballero-Villarraso, Nada Starčević Čizmarević, Borut Peterlin
pmc-11431943.description: There is substantial evidence supporting the neuroprotective effects of the MIND diet in neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s. Our aim was to evaluate the impact of a nutritional intervention (NI) with this diet on multiple sclerosis (MS) patients. The study was conducted in two stages.

pmc-11453914.title: 12626 Non-high-density Lipoprotein Cholesterol For Detecting Dyslipidemia Among Korean Adolescents
pmc-11453914.creator: H K Nam, E Kang, Y J Rhie, K H Lee
pmc-11453914.description: Disclosure: H. Nam: None. E. Kang: None. Y. Rhie: None. K. Lee: None. Objectives: Non-high-density lipoprotein (HDL) cholesterol is an alternative method to assess dyslipidemia. We aimed to assess the validity of non-HDL cholesterol for detecting dyslipidemia among Korean adolescents.

pmc-12621257.title: Benchmarking Structures and UV–Vis Spectra of Iron Complexes Against Experimental Data
pmc-12621257.creator: Renan R. Bertoloni, Vania M. Ramos, Ana Paula de Lima Batista, Antonio G. S. de Oliveira-Filho
pmc-12621257.description: This benchmark study focuses on the evaluation of theoretical methodologies for geometry and ultraviolet–visible (UV–vis) spectral prediction of mononuclear iron coordination complexes. For this purpose, 17 structurally diverse iron complexes with experimentally determined X-ray structures and UV–vis absorption spectra were selected from the literature.

pmc-12672653.title: Usefulness of point-of-care ultrasound for rapid assessment of sarcopenia risk in inpatient frail older people: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12672653.creator: Laisa Socorro Briongos Figuero, Miriam Gabella Martín, Fernando Gil Díez, Graciela López Muñiz, Julia Pérez Nieto, Victoria Olivet de la Fuente, Jesús Franco Rodríguez, Ainhoa Martín Galán, Luis Corral Gudino, José Pablo Miramontes González
pmc-12672653.description: Bedside ultrasound (POCUS) has emerged as a non-invasive, reliable, and practical tool for evaluating muscle mass since sarcopenia poses a significant threat to multimorbidity older people. The aim of the study was to evaluate sarcopenia risk among frail older inpatients using POCUS on rectus femoris muscle (RFM) and explore the relationship between these condition and clinical outcomes.

pmc-13082837.title: ATRX loss in sarcomas is associated with dysregulated gene and transposable element expression, loss of DNA methylation, and worse survival
pmc-13082837.creator: K. Demanelis, J. Leix, M. A. Burgess, B. A. Nacev
pmc-13082837.description: Background:ATRX (α-thalassemia/mental retardation syndrome X-linked) is a tumor suppressor and key regulator of transcriptionally repressive epigenetic states. We investigate the impact of somatic ATRX loss of function on gene expression, DNA methylation, and transposable element (TE) expression in common soft tissue sarcoma tumors, a family of rare cancers.

pmc-13087751.title: Inventory optimization under tri phased demand with dual aging and controlled backlogging
pmc-13087751.creator: E Arunadevi, S Umamaheswari
pmc-13087751.description: SummaryThe proposed study will create a unified inventory model that reduces the overall inventory cost and improves sustainability of seasonal and perishable goods. Seasonal and perishable inventories require superior models that are sensitive to the product attributes and fluctuating consumer demand.

pmc-13098496.title: Short tandem repeat (STR) typing of a deceased individual with an extensive blood transfusion history: A case report
pmc-13098496.creator: Bea G. Gallardo, Minerva D. Sagum, Miriam Ruth M. Dalet, Nelvie Fatima Jane A. Soliven, Paul Ryan L. Sales, Jazelyn M. Salvador, Maria Corazon A. De Ungria, Gayvelline C. Calacal
pmc-13098496.description: Detecting donor DNA in blood samples after multiple allogeneic transfusions remains a persistent concern in forensic human identification, given the limited and variable data. Although some studies have reported no secondary DNA profiles, transfusion-associated microchimerism (TA-MC) has been observed in deceased individuals who received perimortem blood transfusions.

pmc-13421478.title: Rossby wave-modulated orbital precipitation anomalies in the Asia-Pacific region
pmc-13421478.creator: Zhaojie Yu, Lina Song, Zhimin Jian, Mahyar Mohtadi, Yair Rosenthal, Kyung-Sook Yun, Xiaojie Tang, Lei Zhang, Yuanlong Li, Mingmei Xie, Peng Hu, Zehua Song, Franck Bassinot, Christophe Colin, Shiming Wan

pmc-13477352.title: Plasma Apolipoprotein E Levels and Adverse Clinical Outcomes After Ischemic Stroke
pmc-13477352.creator: Lingxiang Ye, Shiliang Xia, Quan Yu, Beiping Song, Yang Liu, Lulu Sun, Xueyu Mao, Xuechun Wu, Min Chu, Huicong Niu, Daoxia Guo, Mengyao Shi, Qi Fang, Jing Yuan, Zhengbao Zhu, Jing Zhao
pmc-13477352.description: BackgroundApolipoprotein E (ApoE) is implicated in the development of cerebrovascular diseases, but its association with the prognosis of ischemic stroke remains unclear. We aimed to explore the associations between plasma ApoE levels and adverse clinical outcomes after ischemic stroke in a prognostic cohort study.MethodWe measured plasma ApoE levels among 5410 patients with ischemic stroke from the Minhang Stroke Cohort study.

pmc-13696597.title: Application of a nursing care bundle combined with a clinical nursing pathway in liver transplantation and its impact on patient self-management: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13696597.creator: Lili Shi, Zhiying Lei, She Wang, Qiuyun Huang, Xiuli Peng, Xiongsheng Mo
pmc-13696597.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to explore the effects of a nursing care bundle combined with a clinical nursing pathway on self-management ability, postoperative biochemical markers, medication adherence, psychological status, and quality of life among liver transplant recipients.MethodsThis study was a single-center, prospective, randomized controlled trial. A total of 103 patients who underwent liver transplantation were initially screened.
